results.ask: What's special about my block? I'm on 46th Ave between Moraga and Noriega.
results.expect: calls about_block; gives the block's own figures and something pinned nearby, with sources; cites
results.answer:
Your block sits about 39 feet above sea level and is just 0.2 miles from Ocean Beach. Most of the homes here were built around 1941, though the oldest is from 1908 and the newest is from 2004 ([SF Assessor-Recorder's 2023 roll](https://data.sf.gov/d/yhqp-riqs)).

A few interesting things are nearby:

*   **Patriotic Model Homes:** Just a block east, at 43rd Avenue, the Freedom House (1942) was one of several model homes with patriotic names built by Henry Doelger as WWII approached ([Western Neighborhoods Project](https://www.outsidelands.org/doelger-types.php)).
*   **Shipwrecks:** About 0.3 miles southwest, the lower hull of the clipper ship *King Philip* (1878) is buried in the sand near the foot of Noriega and Ortega ([NPS Golden Gate NRA](https://home.nps.gov/goga/learn/historyculture/vestiges-shipwrecks.htm)).
*   **Photographs:** The archive has two photographs pinned just 250 feet north of your block ([OpenSFHistory](https://opensfhistory.org/)).

What do you know about your block? I'd love to add it to the notes.

*   **East side:** Monday, 1st and 3rd of the month, from noon to 2pm (next: 2026-11-16) [SF street sweeping schedule](https://data.sf.gov/d/yhqp-riqs).
*   **West side:** Thursday, 1st, 3rd, and 5th of the month, from noon to 2pm (next: 2026-11-19) [SF street sweeping schedule](https://data.sf.gov/d/yhqp-riqs).

Cleaning does not occur on city holidays. Please note that the signs on the block are the last word, as they can change.
